response.changelog:
System
    - New boot animation
    - Ability to view changelogs of available updates (currently buggy, fix will be released soon)
    - Update Android security patch to September 2025. Improve system security.

User experience
    - Some app icons were updated

System
    - Stable MantissaOS based on Android 16
    - New boot animation
    - Ability to view changelogs of available updates
    - Introduces support for the APV codec
    - Adds support for the Seamless App Updates APIs

User experience
    - Full redesign of the operating system, now incorporating the new Material 3 Expressive design language
    - Material 3 redesign for the stock calendar app
    - Introduces Live Updates, a new type of dynamic progress notification
    - Add a new app drawer shortcut to the home screen menu
    - Some app icons were updated
    - Refreshed animations now make using the system more fluid and dynamic

Personalization
    - Introducing an overhauled, customizable Quick Settings: QS tiles can now be resized into smaller or larger sizes in addition to existing functionality
    - Additional system font overlays have been added, allowing more font customization around the system
    - Some stock wallpapers have been temporarily removed, as they were not present in the source repository when this build was compiled
